name: Omalattice
author: MaCleod Walker
description: True 2D spatial scrolling layout for Omarchy & Hyprland with a drag-and-drop live thumbnail minimap, 1:1 finger-following touchpad swipes, 4-way edge peeks, persistent workspace grids, and a live bar settings menu.

barWidget.description: Live settings menu for the Omalattice 2D spatial layout: tune edge peeks, cell gaps, size presets, interactive minimap, and touchpad gestures on the fly.
